Bot.description: Zenthera Patient Support Program (PSP) specialist for patient medication facts from CRM data, read-only: refill history and next refill due date for one patient (recorded shipments only), delayed or long-shipped shipments, and the program exceptions list (overdue refills, delayed shipments, consent pending, open safety reviews, duplicate or uncategorised cases, missing data). Use for 'show today's PSP program exceptions', 'which shipments are delayed', 'when is <patient>'s next refill due'. Not for program policy questions or creating cases.
Bot.label: PSP Medication Support Agent
